title: Logistics Company Platform
summary: Accounting and data-control system for a logistics company: a Flask backend with PostgreSQL behind a React website and React Native apps.
highlights: Flask backend and PostgreSQL database for the company's accounting and data control
Driver app that takes photos and scans data via OCR or QR codes
Captured data appears on the website, where an administrator edits and approves it
note: The code belongs to the client and is not public
